topic: 3D Lidar setup and data collection process
summary_markdown:
The team discussed the procedure for setting up and collecting data from a 3D lidar system, comparing it to 2D methods. The process involves recording video footage alongside sample collection (which can be done at any time). After installation, configuration zones must be set up, and background artifacts need cleaning.

For data capture, the team agreed that while video might make samples redundant, capturing both is ideal. A command line snippet was provided for collecting lidar samples (`./lidar3d-counter_collect_samples`). The sample rate was clarified: 200 frames at 10 frames per second equals 20 seconds of recording time.
decisions: Video recording will be done during the lidar installation process to capture detailed movement and foot traffic patterns.
The team confirmed they would write/document the setup procedure.
action_items: Someone needs to ensure the necessary software is deployed on site for data collection.
Configure zones in the system settings.
Clean up background artifacts generated by the system.
